enumeratedValue.name: PASSWD
enumeratedValue.description: Writing any other value in this field aborts the write operation of the WPEN bit.Always reads as 0.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL_CMD
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Mode. Any access to the MPDDRC is decoded normally. To activate this mode, the command must be followed by a write to the DDR-SDRAM.

enumeratedValue.name: NOP_CMD
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues a NOP command when the DDR-SDRAM device is accessed regardless of the cycle. To activate this mode, the command must be followed by a write to the DDR-SDRAM.

enumeratedValue.name: PRCGALL_CMD
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues the All Banks Precharge command when the DDR-SDRAM device is accessed regardless of the cycle. To activate this mode, the command must be followed by a write to the SDRAM.

enumeratedValue.name: LMR_CMD
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues a Load Mode Register command when the DDR-SDRAM device is accessed regardless of the cycle. To activate this mode, the command must be followed by a write to the DDR-SDRAM.

enumeratedValue.name: RFSH_CMD
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues an Auto-Refresh command when the DDR-SDRAM device is accessed regardless of the cycle. Previously, an All Banks Precharge command must be issued. To activate this mode, the command must be followed by a write to the DDR-SDRAM.

enumeratedValue.name: EXT_LMR_CMD
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues an Extended Load Mode Register command when the SDRAM device is accessed regardless of the cycle. To activate this mode, the command must be followed by a write to the DDR-SDRAM. The write in the DDR-SDRAM must be done in the appropriate bank.

enumeratedValue.name: DEEP_MD
enumeratedValue.description: Deep Power mode: Access to Deep Powerdown mode

enumeratedValue.name: LPDDR2_CMD
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues an LPDDR2 Mode Register command when the device is accessed regardless of the cycle. To activate this mode, the Mode Register command must be followed by a write to the low-power DDR2-SDRAM.

enumeratedValue.name: 9_COL_BITS
enumeratedValue.description: 9 bits to define the column number, up to 512 columns

enumeratedValue.name: 10_COL_BITS
enumeratedValue.description: 10 bits to define the column number, up to 1024 columns

enumeratedValue.name: 11_COL_BITS
enumeratedValue.description: 11 bits to define the column number, up to 2048 columns

enumeratedValue.name: 12_COL_BITS
enumeratedValue.description: 12 bits to define the column number, up to 4096 columns

enumeratedValue.name: 11_ROW_BITS
enumeratedValue.description: 11 bits to define the row number, up to 2048 rows

enumeratedValue.name: 12_ROW_BITS
enumeratedValue.description: 12 bits to define the row number, up to 4096 rows

enumeratedValue.name: 13_ROW_BITS
enumeratedValue.description: 13 bits to define the row number, up to 8192 rows

enumeratedValue.name: 14_ROW_BITS
enumeratedValue.description: 14 bits to define the row number, up to 16384 rows

enumeratedValue.name: DDR2_EXITCALIB
enumeratedValue.description: Exit from OCD Calibration mode and maintain settings

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_SHARED
enumeratedValue.description: DQM is not shared with another controller

enumeratedValue.name: SHARED
enumeratedValue.description: DQM is shared with another controller

enumeratedValue.name: OFF
enumeratedValue.description: DQS/DDR_DATA phase error correction is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: ON
enumeratedValue.description: DQS/DDR_DATA phase error correction is enabled

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_2_BANKS
enumeratedValue.description: Any type of memory devices except of low cost, low density Low Power DDR1.

enumeratedValue.name: 2_BANKS_LPDDR1
enumeratedValue.description: Low-cost and low-density low-power DDR1. These devices have a density of 32 Mbits and are organized as two internal banks. To use this feature, the user has to define the type of memory and the data bus width (see Section 8.8 "MPDDRC Memory Device Register").The 16-bit memory device is organized as 2 banks, 9 columns and 11 rows.

enumeratedValue.name: 8_BANKS
enumeratedValue.description: 8 banks. Only possible when using the DDR2-SDRAM and low-power DDR2-SDRAM devices.

enumeratedValue.name: SEQUENTIAL
enumeratedValue.description: Method for address mapping where banks alternate at each last DDR-SDRAM page of the current bank.

enumeratedValue.name: INTERLEAVED
enumeratedValue.description: Method for address mapping where banks alternate at each DDR-SDRAM end of page of the current bank.

field.name: TMRD
field.description: Load Mode Register Command to Activate or Refresh Command

field.name: TXSNR
field.description: Exit Self-refresh Delay to Non-Read Command

field.name: TXSRD
field.description: Exit Self-refresh Delay to Read Command

field.name: TXP
field.description: Exit Powerdown Delay to First Command

field.name: TXARD
field.description: Exit Active Power Down Delay to Read Command in Mode "Fast Exit"

field.name: TXARDS
field.description: Exit Active Power Down Delay to Read Command in Mode "Slow Exit"

enumeratedValue.name: NOLOWPOWER
enumeratedValue.description: Low-power feature is inhibited. No Powerdown, Self-refresh and Deep-power modes are issued to the DDR-SDRAM device.

enumeratedValue.name: SELFREFRESH
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues a self-refresh command to the DDR-SDRAM device, the clock(s) is/are deactivated and the CKE signal is set low. The DDR-SDRAM device leaves the Self-refresh mode when accessed and reenters it after the access.

enumeratedValue.name: POWERDOWN
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues a Powerdown command to the DDR-SDRAM device after each access, the CKE signal is set low. The DDR-SDRAM device leaves the Powerdown mode when accessed and reenters it after the access.

enumeratedValue.name: DEEPPOWERDOWN
enumeratedValue.description: The MPDDRC issues a Deep Powerdown command to the low-power DDR-SDRAM device.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: No power-off sequence applied to LPDDR2.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: A power-off sequence is applied to the LPDDR2 device. CKE is forced low.

field.name: TIMEOUT
field.description: Time Between Last Transfer and Low-Power Mode

enumeratedValue.name: NONE
enumeratedValue.description: SDRAM Low-power mode is activated immediately after the end of the last transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: DELAY_64_CLK
enumeratedValue.description: SDRAM Low-power mode is activated 64 clock cycles after the end of the last transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: DELAY_128_CLK
enumeratedValue.description: SDRAM Low-power mode is activated 128 clock cycles after the end of the last transfer.

enumeratedValue.name: DDR2_FAST_EXIT
enumeratedValue.description: Fast Exit from Power Down. DDR2-SDRAM devices only.

enumeratedValue.name: DDR2_SLOW_EXIT
enumeratedValue.description: Slow Exit from Power Down. DDR2-SDRAM devices only.

field.name: UPD_MR
field.description: Update Load Mode Register and Extended Mode Register

enumeratedValue.name: NO_UPDATE
enumeratedValue.description: Update of Load Mode and Extended Mode registers is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: UPDATE_SHAREDBUS
enumeratedValue.description: MPDDRC shares an external bus. Automatic update is done during a refresh command and a pending read or write access in the SDRAM device.

enumeratedValue.name: UPDATE_NOSHAREDBUS
enumeratedValue.description: MPDDRC does not share an external bus. Automatic update is done before entering Self-refresh mode.

enumeratedValue.name: UNLIMITED
enumeratedValue.description: Unlimited Length Burst-No predicted end of burst is generated, therefore INCR bursts coming from this master can only be broken if the Slave Slot Cycle Limit is reached. If the Slot Cycle Limit is not reached, the burst is normally completed by the master, at the latest, on the next AHB 1 Kbyte address boundary, allowing up to 256-beat word bursts or 128-beat double-word bursts.This value should not be used in the very particular case of a master capable of performing back-to-back undefined length bursts on a single slave, since this could indefinitely freeze the slave arbitration and thus prevent another master from accessing this slave.

enumeratedValue.name: SINGLE
enumeratedValue.description: Single Access-The undefined length burst is treated as a succession of single accesses, allowing re-arbitration at each beat of the INCR burst or bursts sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: 4_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 4-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 4-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 4 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 8_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 8-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 8-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 8 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 16_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 16-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 16-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 16 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 32_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 32-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 32-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 32 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 64_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 64-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 64-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 64 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 128_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 128-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 128-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 128 beats.Unless duly needed, the ULBT should be left at its default 0 value for power saving.

field.name: SLOT_CYCLE
field.description: Maximum Bus Grant Duration for Masters

enumeratedValue.name: NONE
enumeratedValue.description: No Default Master-At the end of the current slave access, if no other master request is pending, the slave is disconnected from all masters.This results in a one clock cycle latency for the first access of a burst transfer or for a single access.

enumeratedValue.name: LAST
enumeratedValue.description: Last Default Master-At the end of the current slave access, if no other master request is pending, the slave stays connected to the last master having accessed it.This results in not having one clock cycle latency when the last master tries to access the slave again.

enumeratedValue.name: FIXED
enumeratedValue.description: Fixed Default Master-At the end of the current slave access, if no other master request is pending, the slave connects to the fixed master the number that has been written in the FIXED_DEFMSTR field.This results in not having one clock cycle latency when the fixed master tries to access the slave again.

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enables the TRNG to Provide Random Values

enumeratedValue.name: PASSWD
enumeratedValue.description: Writing any other value in this field aborts the write operation.

enumeratedValue.name: BITS_10
enumeratedValue.description: 10-bit resolution. For higher resolution by averaging, refer to Section 8.18 "ADC Extended Mode Register".

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Mode: The ADC core and reference voltage circuitry are kept ON between conversions.

enumeratedValue.name: SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Sleep Mode: The ADC core and reference voltage circuitry are OFF between conversions.

enumeratedValue.name: NUM_ORDER
enumeratedValue.description: Normal Mode: The controller converts channels in a simple numeric order depending only on the channel index.

enumeratedValue.name: REG_ORDER
enumeratedValue.description: User Sequence Mode: The sequence respects what is defined in ADC_SEQR1 register and can be used to convert the same channel several times.

field.name: XRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure XPOS Ready Interrupt Enable

field.name: YRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure YPOS Ready Interrupt Enable

field.name: PRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure Pressure Ready Interrupt Enable

field.name: XRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure XPOS Ready Interrupt Disable

field.name: YRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure YPOS Ready Interrupt Disable

field.name: PRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure Pressure Ready Interrupt Disable

field.name: XRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure XPOS Ready Interrupt Mask

field.name: YRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure YPOS Ready Interrupt Mask

field.name: PRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Measure Pressure Ready Interrupt Mask

field.name: XRDY
field.description: Touchscreen XPOS Measure Ready (cleared on read)

field.name: YRDY
field.description: Touchscreen YPOS Measure Ready (cleared on read)

field.name: PRDY
field.description: Touchscreen Pressure Measure Ready (cleared on read)

enumeratedValue.name: LOW
enumeratedValue.description: When the converted data is lower than the low threshold of the window, generates the COMPE flag in ADC_ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH
enumeratedValue.description: When the converted data is higher than the high threshold of the window, generates the COMPE flag in ADC_ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: IN
enumeratedValue.description: When the converted data is in the comparison window, generates the COMPE flag in ADC_ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: OUT
enumeratedValue.description: When the converted data is out of the comparison window, generates the COMPE flag in ADC_ISR.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_AVERAGE
enumeratedValue.description: No averaging. ADC sample rate is maximum.

enumeratedValue.name: OSR4
enumeratedValue.description: 1-bit enhanced resolution by averaging. ADC sample rate divided by 4.

enumeratedValue.name: OSR16
enumeratedValue.description: 2-bit enhanced resolution by averaging. ADC sample rate divided by 16.

enumeratedValue.name: MULTI_TRIG_AVERAGE
enumeratedValue.description: The average requests several trigger events.

enumeratedValue.name: SINGLE_TRIG_AVERAGE
enumeratedValue.description: The average requests only one trigger event.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_FILTER
enumeratedValue.description: No Filtering. Only one ADC conversion per measure

enumeratedValue.name: NO_TRIGGER
enumeratedValue.description: No trigger, only software trigger can start conversions

enumeratedValue.name: PEN_TRIG
enumeratedValue.description: Pen Detect Trigger (shall be selected only if PENDET is set and TSAMOD = Touchscreen only mode)

enumeratedValue.name: PERIOD_TRIG
enumeratedValue.description: ADC internal periodic trigger (see field TRGPER)

enumeratedValue.name: PASSWD
enumeratedValue.description: Writing any other value in this field aborts the write operation of the WPEN bit.Always reads as 0

field.name: HOLD
field.description: TWD Hold Time versus TWCK falling

field.name: RXRDY
field.description: Receive Holding Register Ready (cleared by reading TWI_RHR)

field.name: TXRDY
field.description: Transmit Holding Register Ready (cleared by writing TWI_THR)

field.name: EOSACC
field.description: End Of Slave Access (cleared on read)

field.name: RXRDY
field.description: Receive Holding Register Ready Interrupt Enable

field.name: TXRDY
field.description: Transmit Holding Register Ready Interrupt Enable

field.name: EOSACC

enumeratedValue.name: UNLIMITED
enumeratedValue.description: Unlimited Length Burst-No predicted end of burst is generated, therefore INCR bursts coming from this master can only be broken if the Slave Slot Cycle Limit is reached. If the Slot Cycle Limit is not reached, the burst is normally completed by the master, at the latest, on the next AHB 1 Kbyte address boundary, allowing up to 256-beat word bursts or 128-beat double-word bursts.This value should not be used in the very particular case of a master capable of performing back-to-back undefined length bursts on a single slave, since this could indefinitely freeze the slave arbitration and thus prevent another master from accessing this slave.

enumeratedValue.name: SINGLE
enumeratedValue.description: Single Access-The undefined length burst is treated as a succession of single accesses, allowing re-arbitration at each beat of the INCR burst or bursts sequence.

enumeratedValue.name: 4_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 4-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 4-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 4 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 8_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 8-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 8-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 8 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 16_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 16-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 16-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 16 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 32_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 32-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 32-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 32 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 64_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 64-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 64-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 64 beats.

enumeratedValue.name: 128_BEAT
enumeratedValue.description: 128-beat Burst-The undefined length burst or bursts sequence is split into 128-beat bursts or less, allowing re-arbitration every 128 beats.Unless duly needed, the ULBT should be left at its default 0 value for power saving.

field.name: SLOT_CYCLE
field.description: Maximum Bus Grant Duration for Masters

enumeratedValue.name: NONE
enumeratedValue.description: No Default Master-At the end of the current slave access, if no other master request is pending, the slave is disconnected from all masters.This results in a one clock cycle latency for the first access of a burst transfer or for a single access.

enumeratedValue.name: LAST
enumeratedValue.description: Last Default Master-At the end of the current slave access, if no other master request is pending, the slave stays connected to the last master having accessed it.This results in not having one clock cycle latency when the last master tries to access the slave again.

enumeratedValue.name: FIXED
enumeratedValue.description: Fixed Default Master-At the end of the current slave access, if no other master request is pending, the slave connects to the fixed master the number that has been written in the FIXED_DEFMSTR field.This results in not having one clock cycle latency when the fixed master tries to access the slave again.

enumeratedValue.name: PASSWD
enumeratedValue.description: Writing any other value in this field aborts the write operation of the WPEN bit.Always reads as 0.
